mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the collecting ducts was most worthwhile: the result connects the hormone signal to water returning to blood and less water remaining in urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the nerve endings and pituitary vessels felt somewhat repetitive after the earlier result had already shown ADH released into blood, although it clarified the physical route.

surprise.text: The separate construction of the brain-to-blood route clarified that nerve endings release ADH directly into nearby blood vessels.

arbitrary.text: The separate route construction felt a little arbitrary because the sensor combination had already produced blood carrying ADH; its purpose became clearer when it was attached to the body.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it built on these connections with a new problem. This chapter explained the water-saving pathway clearly, though several combinations felt predictable.
